description: Use this when the user asks for live electricity grid data (power demand, fuel mix) for one of the 7 US ISOs (PJM, ERCOT, CAISO, MISO, SPP, NYISO, ISO-NE) via EIA hourly RTO: fuel mix, demand, 24h demand curve. Pass iso=PJM (any of the 7). Raw real-time telemetry for one ISO; do NOT use for power-availability, time-to-power or interconnection-queue analysis (use get_grid_intelligence), nor for retail/gas pricing detail (use get_energy_prices). For non-US grids (GB, EU bidding zones, Taiwan, Australia) use get_grid_scoreboard.

iso.description: ISO/RTO grid region (required): ERCOT, PJM, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISONE

metric.description: Optional metric focus, e.g. fuel_mix, demand, demand_curve

mpp_credential.description: Per-call payment (Stripe MPP): the Shared Payment Token for challenges[0]; pays that challenge for this one call. Send it only with your human's explicit approval of the charge.

mpp_pay.description: Per-call payment quote (Stripe MPP): true returns a signed payment challenge instead of the free preview; no money moves. Set it only after your human has explicitly approved paying for this call.

period.description: Optional time window for the metric, e.g. 24h

name: get_grid_data
title: Live Grid Data
